text.offer: You have served me well enough to be trusted with one of my battle-mages: an axe in one hand and Qor's acids in the other. They will wrap you in shadow, give your blade an unholy edge, and send their own reflections against your foes. Stand before me and ask for a companion. Look after them: their magic grows as you grow stronger.
text.progress: Stand before the Duke and ask him for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
text.complete: Good. Fight beside your battle-mage, and the bond between you will grow. Keep them close, and keep them alive.

steps.objective: Take a companion into your service
